name: Chacaltaya summit
why: From the old ski lodge of the world's highest ski slope, a short steep walk to 5,421 m with Huayna Potosí, Illimani and the lake in view.
book: Day tour from La Paz (1.5 h by road), often with Valle de la Luna.
dangers: Altitude over 5,300 m: walk slowly, only after days in La Paz.

points.name: Chacaltaya ski lodge
points.note: The old lodge at 5,300 m where the glacier used to be.

points.name: Chacaltaya
points.note: The 5,421 m summit, the Cordillera Real in a line.
